build_summary.plate_source: New textless, logo-free full-canvas plates generated per canvas at exact target dimensions via gpt-image-2 (call_gpt_image.py), each depicting a navy ground with periwinkle circle/arc geometry framing a real smartphone product-grid UI mockup with a small live-video bubble in the lower portion of the canvas, and a fully quiet navy zone reserved for text.
build_summary.overlay: One fixed-canvas root per size, single full-canvas plate image, and live HTML/CSS text nodes (data-cq-role=text/logo/cta) for eyebrow, headline, subhead and CTA, plus the emplifi reverse (white) logo SVG placed at natural aspect ratio via a constrained wrapper with object-fit:contain.
build_summary.fonts: Inter 400/500/600/700 loaded via @font-face from brand_kit/fonts/*.ttf; no browser fallback used.

type_scale_usage.headline: h1 48px (all 4 canvases, unchanged)
type_scale_usage.cta_label: body 16px (short label text, not scaled up or down to fit any canvas)

build_summary.layout_per_canvas: Text block position/width was adjusted per canvas to fit the quiet region of that canvas's plate (e.g. story places the CTA near the bottom third to suit a vertical, thumb-scroll format while landscape keeps the whole block in a narrower left column) - no font size was ever changed to make copy fit.

brand_data_inconsistencies_found.issue: tokens.json lists secondary #5B5BD6, h1 56px, and radii [16px], all of which disagree with DESIGN.md (secondary #6765FE, h1 48px, border-radius 12px with pill CTAs). Per invariant 5, DESIGN.md is the brand.
brand_data_inconsistencies_found.resolution: Used DESIGN.md's values throughout: #6765FE for the periwinkle accent/eyebrow, h1 at 48px for every headline, and fully-rounded pill CTAs per the Shape section's explicit CTA rule. tokens.json was not read as a source of any value.

brand_data_inconsistencies_found.issue: Manifest includes a 'logo_lockup' entry (partner-lockup.svg) tagged brand_kit_id 'bk-kahua-2026', which does not match this request's brand (Emplifi, bk-emplifi-2026).
brand_data_inconsistencies_found.resolution: Not used, per the brand-binding rule that only manifest assets whose brand_kit_id matches the pinned kit may be placed. Used emplifi-logo-white.svg (kit bk-emplifi-2026) instead, since all four plates place the logo on a navy/photographic ground.

brand_data_inconsistencies_found.issue: The inspiration's CTA is a solid orange filled pill, which conflicts with DESIGN.md's explicit rule that orange is reserved for the CTA and is never used as a fill (a CTA is an orange label inside a 2px orange outline on navy).
brand_data_inconsistencies_found.resolution: Treated the inspiration as composition/rhythm reference only (per invariant 6): kept its general layout idea (headline block over a photo/UI element framed by periwinkle circles and a thin connecting line, in the lower half) but built the CTA as DESIGN.md specifies - an orange outlined, unfilled pill label - not a filled button.

could_not_do: None - all four requested canvases (square, landscape, portrait, story) were built with every required copy string live as HTML text, the Emplifi reverse logo placed at its natural aspect ratio, and a DESIGN.md-compliant CTA. No brief/legal copy was supplied in the request, so no brief or legal line was added.
notes: Not published or deployed anywhere; this run only stages the files above.
